content: Use a simple workflow: start with your image, turn it into a storyboard using Custom GPT Image 2.0, then generate the video in Seedance 2.0.
tips: Use a simple workflow: start with your image, turn it into a storyboard using Custom GPT Image 2.0, then generate the video in Seedance 2.0.

es.content: Utiliza un flujo de trabajo simple: comienza con tu imagen, conviértela en un storyboard usando Custom GPT Image 2.0, luego genera el video en Seedance 2.0.

fr.content: Utilisez un flux de travail simple : commencez par votre image, transformez-la en storyboard en utilisant Custom GPT Image 2.0, puis générez la vidéo dans Seedance 2.0.

ja.content:

pt.content: Use um fluxo de trabalho simples: comece com sua imagem, transforme-a em um storyboard usando o Custom GPT Image 2.0, depois gere o vídeo no Seedance 2.0.
